response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(CAST(HGB AS REAL) / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall

assumptions.assumption: The all-patient average is the unweighted mean of per-patient ratios (each patient counts once), over patients with a non-null ratio.
Records with HCT of 0 are treated as missing ratios (NULLIF), and records with NULL HGB or HCT are ignored in the per-patient ratio average.
Patients whose PIC values are all NULL have a NULL avg_pic, which AVG skips in the summary average of average PIC.
